systems.system: Civil registration and vital statistics system (Dad-dhigista iyo Tirakoobka Xaaladaha Madaniga)
systems.country_label: Population Registration and Civil Status Statistics Law, Law No. 46
systems.owner: Agaasinka Adeegyada Dad-dhigista iyo Tirakoobka Xaaladaha Madaniga ah (Registrar General), under the Ministry of Interior, Federal Affairs and Reconciliation
systems.tiers: federal, federal member states, Banadir, district, embassies and consulates

note: Civil registration law (births, deaths, marriages, divorces, adoptions, family register); it sets up no identity number, register of persons or identity card, so it is class other; it names the national identification body (NIRA) only as a seat on the National Committee.
